title: Bio
text:
Enjoyer of all things mathematical and musical; I’m tech support for your data & science problems.
I like to solve real problem by dissecting and developing the data and tools required to understand them. Some of my research interests include scientific computing, unsupervised learning, audio & signal processing, clustering, and tensor factorization. This has lead to interdisciplinary collaborations in fields such as computer science, statistics, geology, biology, and music.
Teaching undergraduate topics like calculus, Python, and linear regression across different universities taught me learning goes both ways. I strive to see topics from multiple views to best distill complex ideas and train the next generation of problem solvers.
When I’m not researching, coding, or teaching, you can find me singing and jamming with other musicians. My award winning a cappella arrangements and audio production & mixing can be found on YouTube and streaming platforms.
Please reach out if you’d like to collaborate (academically or musically) and I would be happy to connect!

text: Curriculum Vitae

title: Research
text:
Projects


Multiscale Optimization: Optimize over continuous functions at gradually finer discretizations with greedy multiscale








Tensor Factorization: Input geological data tensor processed with BlockTensorFactorization.jl, a Julia package for constrained tensor factorization


Rank Recovery: Estimate rank of a noisy low-rank matrix with Numerical Epsilon-Rank








Constrained Optimization: Comparison of nonnegative and sum-to-one constraint enforcing operations from slowest (Euclidean Simplex Projection) to fastest (KL-Projection and renormalization) applied to a matrix factorization problem


Signal Decomposition: Separation of two frequency and amplitude modulated signals using SRMD: Sparse Random Mode Decomposition
